what: FINAL competition artifact: 7-stream deployable ensemble, all 10,000 labelled series

training.row_budget_rule: 1.25x dev, nearest thousand, pre-declared before the freeze

calibration.fitted_on: cross-fitted OOF over folds_final10k, all 10,000 series

lockbox.note: the 2,000-series lockbox is FINAL-FIT TRAINING DATA here; no wave-4 score was taken from it

zip_determinism.note: pack_dir stamps every member with the 1980 zip epoch and fixed permissions, so source_zip_sha256 and model_zip_sha256 depend on contents and paths only. Before this fix they encoded checkout mtimes and could never have matched a rebuild.

clean_checkout_reproduction.method: fresh git clone of the branch into a new directory
clean_checkout_reproduction.caveat: the notebook and .py themselves are NOT bit-reproducible across builds: the boot cell embeds a build timestamp. The source and model zip hashes are the reproducible identities and are what to verify.

clean_production_release.what: the RT-600 artifact rebuilt on a branch that DESCENDS FROM production/rt600 and carries only the audited reliability fixes. Same experiment, same model, same calibration, same 500 features: no new experiment id, no new score, no model selection, no RT ID.
clean_production_release.not_a_merge: THIS IS NOT A MERGE OF THE RESEARCH LINEAGE. engineering/rt600-final-reliability-2026 is rooted on the CRF research tip and carries 152 commits production does not have. The fixes were transplanted path by path; the research lineage was not merged.
clean_production_release.authorised_by: repository owner, 2026-08-26, APPROVE RT-600 RELEASE (clean production-descended lineage)
clean_production_release.build_command: python research/scripts/build_submission.py --model <models/final10k_ensemble> --out submissions/C_ensemble_deployable.ipynb --title "Structural Break Real-Time: 7-stream deployable ensemble, all 10,000 series"
clean_production_release.builder: research/scripts/build_submission.py AS IT EXISTS ON production/rt600 -- the P=4 / writable-payload builder. The engineering branch's copy is OLDER (P=1, ./_sbr_payload_<pid>) because the research lineage forked before LB-002..LB-004; using it would have regressed the cloud runner fix.

model_zip_sha256.note: BYTE-IDENTICAL to the frozen record AND to the engineering release artifact. The model was not rebuilt, retrained or reselected; the packer re-emitted the same directory to the same bytes.

feature_manifest_sha256.note: the RT-600 500-column manifest is unmoved, so ProductionModel.load still accepts this model.

notebook_sha256.note: the notebook and .py are not bit-reproducible across builds -- the boot cell embeds a build timestamp. The zip hashes are the reproducible identities.

added_vs_production_freeze: sbr/stream/_fp.py  -- the arm64 FMA emulation the parity fix needs

payload_contents.shipped_module_set_note: on this lineage MODULE_ORDER IS the frozen seven and StreamEngine defaults to it. The MODULE_ORDER / PRODUCTION_MODULES split exists only on the research lineage, where a module was appended; there is nothing to split here.
